currentSkills.currentText: 主公的回合开始时，你可以记录一张普通锦囊牌。每回合限一次，当其他角色使用记录牌后，你摸两张牌并将之分配给任意角色，然后重新记录一张普通锦囊牌。

限定技，出牌阶段，你可以令一名角色增加1点体力上限、回复1点体力并摸三张牌，若其为：
•忠臣，当主公死亡时与主公交换身份牌；
•反贼，当其被主公或忠臣杀死时，主公方获胜。

versionDifferences.difference: Only current ordinary OL hero355 character DongZhao binds3063/3064 here; no old variant folded into this key.

interpretationBoundaries: The currently available primary text does not specify multiple Zaowang loyalist succession order. Seat order selects the first currently living loyalist recipient; later heirs remain armed for later lord death.
Only actual native death killer attribution grants the special rebel victory. Source-free HP loss has no killer.
Zaowang grants store activation-time role privately on the recipient; public evidence contains only owner and target.

formalEntries.record: Two strict subject=owner turnStartBeforeNormalFlow bindings, own and otherLiving. Existing foreign-turn collection opts in only for XianlueRecord. Candidate qualification reads the actual turn subject and requires the real living lord in identity mode. Existing only-owner parser protocol is unchanged.
formalEntries.reward: CardUseCompleted ownerRelation=observer, no subject field, actual other actor and recorded effective kind; no response uses. Issued actual-turn once receipt, exact private drawn entities, native movement children, mandatory arbitrary-seat distribution and re-record.
formalEntries.identity: Recipient-owned immutable private activation-role grant; genuine native DeathFrame and killer attribution. Loyalist succession precedes native death reveal/reward/winner evaluation; rebel special winner overrides only the actual identity death condition.
